title: My progress is never updated
body:
My progress is never updated, I reach my goals yet nothing get updated. 
It’s really bad, I get motivated by the goals, however now I reach and yet it shows that I didn’t hit the target, I get really frustrated because of this. 
I reached February’s goal and January’s goal yet nothing was updated, my streaks also never updated. FIX IT!
